messages:
Alex Chen: Quick heads-up — we need to lock the vendor capacity handoffs and embargo windows for H100/H200/B200, MI300, and Gaudi. Primary goals: (1) clear handoff points between vendor supply and our marketplace listings, (2) SI onboarding windows, (3) single-point press embargo date. Who can own the cross-cloud sequencing?

Priya Patel: I can own sequencing. I think we should prioritize by availability and region constraints: H100 -> MI300 -> Gaudi -> B200 for early APAC availability.

Jonah Rivera: +1 on regional prioritization. Quick note: Gaudi driver validation still has a blocking CI failure for fp16 kernels. Tagging @Samira — can infra escalate?

Samira Kaur: On it. I've kicked off an extended test matrix against the lab image (gaudi-compat:v2). Failing test is "kv-cache eviction" on long contexts. Will try a kernel fallback in the next run and report results by EOD.

Elena Morris: For marketplace listing: legal needs final embargo dates at least 72 hours before public announcement. Product marketing and PR want a soft launch window first so SIs can finish integration. Recommend an internal announce (partners + SI) 5 days before public.

Priya Patel: Proposed timeline (tentative):

```
- Day 0: Vendor confirms capacity and driver baseline
- Day 3: Redwood internal announce to SI partners + compliance
- Day 5: Marketplace soft-listing (restricted visibility)
- Day 8: Public press embargo lift
- Day 14: Full open marketplace rollout with regional flares
```

Priya Patel: Thoughts? This gives us time for last-minute QA and press checks.

Jonah Rivera: Sounds reasonable. Two asks: (a) we need a fallback model variant for each vendor in case capacity drops (lower-ram quantized model), (b) add a preflight step to run a prompt-sample smoke test across latency SLOs.

Alex Chen: Good calls. @Nate (VendorOps) — can you own vendor-side fallback coordination and provide a CSV with expected first-week capacity per region? We need numbers to inform rollout gating rules in the console.

Nate (VendorOps): I can take that. I'll pull numbers from vendor forecasts and add a column for "compatibility risk" (driver/firmware). Will share CSV by tomorrow morning.

Samira Kaur: Update: kernel fallback reduces throughput ~12% but fixes kv-cache eviction. Will run another pass with smaller batch sizes to see if we can keep latency SLOs. If that holds, Gaudi can be in the Day 5 soft-listing.

Elena Morris: PR checklist items: embargo notice content, partner quote approvals, marketplace SKU descriptions, and a runbook for patching post-announcement. I'll synthesize and send a doc. Also, legal flagged co-marketing logos; need partner logo approvals 3 days before public.

Alex Chen: Great. Action items summary: Priya sequencing + timeline (owner), Nate vendor capacity CSV (owner), Samira infra kernel test and latency pass (owner), Elena PR/legal checklist (owner), Jonah prepare fallback variants + smoke test harness (owner). I'll create a narrow channel for coordinated handoffs and a release ticket in JIRA.

DeployBot: Reminder — when you create the release ticket, include the tag `hw-onramp-embargo` so CI and infra pipelines pick up the correct images.

Priya Patel: Thanks all. I'll post the updated timeline and the soft-listing gating criteria in the new channel in 30m. :thumbsup:
